description: UK persons with significant control (PSC register) of a UK company, live from Companies House, the official UK registry: LEGAL-ENTITY controllers only since 2026-09-19 (corporate entities and legal persons: name, register identification, natures of control as ownership/voting bands, notification dates) plus the official PSC statements and the listed-company exemption flag. Natural-person controllers are COUNTED in personnes_physiques_omises and never named (GDPR, CJEU C-798/24 Jautiva). Ceased PSCs are excluded by default (inclure_cesses adds them with their ceased date). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

company_number.description: Companies House company number, 8 characters incl. leading zeros, e.g. 00102498 or SC123456

inclure_cesses.description: Include ceased PSCs (with their ceased_on date). Default false.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_uk_beneficial_owners

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: UK persons with significant control (PSC, legal entities)
